nodes.speaker: character-commander
nodes.line: Dusk comes down over the reeds at the ford. Nobody follows you from the bridge.

nodes.speaker: class-cleric
nodes.line: Eat something and sleep. Nobody is hurt worse than tired, and tired mends by morning.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: He showed us his plate and his flanks and dared us to try. Going round him gets us nowhere.

nodes.speaker: class-barbarian
nodes.line: I don't need to go round it. I need to go through it. Show me where a plate like that is weakest, and I'll learn the swing tonight.
